info.title: EpiSuite API
info.description: Chemical property prediction and environmental assessment API. Calculates properties like LogKow, Henry's Law constant, biodegradation rates, bioconcentration factors, and more from SMILES or CAS numbers.

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI specification JSON document for this API
Search for chemicals by name or CAS number

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Chemical name or CAS number to search for

get.description: Get an SVG rendering of a chemical structure from its SMILES notation

200.description: SVG image of the chemical structure

get.description: Submit a chemical for property prediction calculations. Provide either SMILES or CAS number. Results include LogKow, melting/boiling points, vapor pressure, water solubility, Henry's Law constant, biodegradation rates, bioconcentration factors, atmospheric half-life, hydrolysis, fugacity model, sewage treatment model, dermal permeability, and ECOSAR aquatic toxicity predictions.

parameters.name: smiles
parameters.description: SMILES notation of the chemical. Either smiles or cas is required.

parameters.name: cas
parameters.description: CAS registry number. Either smiles or cas is required.

parameters.name: modules
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of modules to run. If not specified, all modules are run. Valid values: logKow, mpbpvp, waterSolubilityFromLogKow, waterSolubilityFromWaterNt, henrysLawConstant, logKoa, logKoc, biodegradationRate, hydrocarbonBiodegradationRate, bioconcentration, aerosolAdsorptionFraction, atmosphericHalfLife, hydrolysis, waterVolatilization, sewageTreatmentModel, fugacityModel, dermalPermeability, ecosar, aimanalogs

parameters.name: userLogKow
parameters.description: User-provided octanol-water partition coefficient (log Kow) override

parameters.name: userLogKoa
parameters.description: User-provided octanol-air partition coefficient (log Koa) override

parameters.name: userLogKoc
parameters.description: User-provided soil adsorption coefficient (log Koc) override (L/kg)

parameters.name: userAtmosphericHydroxylRadicalConcentration
parameters.description: User-provided atmospheric hydroxyl radical concentration (radicals/cm3). Default: 1.5e6

parameters.name: userAtmosphericDaylightHours
parameters.description: User-provided average daylight hours for atmospheric calculations. Default: 12

parameters.name: userBiodegradationRateRemoveMetals
parameters.description: Whether to remove metals from biodegradation rate calculation. Default: true

parameters.name: userStpHalfLifePrimaryClarifier
parameters.description: User-provided STP primary clarifier half-life (hours). Default: 10000

parameters.name: userStpHalfLifeAerationVessel
parameters.description: User-provided STP aeration vessel half-life (hours). Default: 10000

parameters.name: userStpHalfLifeSettlingTank
parameters.description: User-provided STP settling tank half-life (hours). Default: 10000

parameters.name: userFugacityHalfLifeAir
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model air half-life (hours). Default: 0 (calculated from atmospheric half-life)

parameters.name: userFugacityHalfLifeWater
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model water half-life (hours). Default: 0 (calculated from biodegradation)

parameters.name: userFugacityHalfLifeSoil
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model soil half-life (hours). Default: 0 (calculated from biodegradation)

parameters.name: userFugacityHalfLifeSediment
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model sediment half-life (hours). Default: 0 (calculated from biodegradation)

parameters.name: userFugacityEmissionRateAir
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model air emission rate (kg/hour). Default: 1000

parameters.name: userFugacityEmissionRateWater
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model water emission rate (kg/hour). Default: 1000

parameters.name: userFugacityEmissionRateSoil
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model soil emission rate (kg/hour). Default: 1000

parameters.name: userFugacityEmissionRateSediment
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model sediment emission rate (kg/hour). Default: 0

parameters.name: userFugacityAdvectionTimeAir
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model air advection residence time (hours). Default: 100

parameters.name: userFugacityAdvectionTimeWater
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model water advection residence time (hours). Default: 1000

parameters.name: userFugacityAdvectionTimeSoil
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model soil advection residence time (hours). Default: 0

parameters.name: userFugacityAdvectionTimeSediment
parameters.description: User-provided fugacity model sediment advection residence time (hours). Default: 50000

200.description: Calculation results containing property predictions from all requested modules

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameter, invalid CAS ID, or invalid input

404.description: CAS ID was not found in the database

modules.description: List of modules that were run
